interventions.detail: README has no CPU install path; installed CPU paddlepaddle==3.3.1 from PyPI and paddleformers editable without the paddlefleet extra
pip must exist in the venv (paddleformers does `import pip` at import time); used `uv venv --seed`
qwen3/modeling.py: make gpt_provider/paddlefleet import optional and alias Qwen3ForCausalLM(Pipe) to the pure-Paddle *Deprecated classes when paddlefleet (GPU-only) is missing
nn/norm.py: skip fused_rms_norm_ext (no CPU kernel) for CPU tensors and use the plain RMSNorm path
model_utils.from_pretrained: on CPU, map dtype bfloat16/float16 to float32 because Paddle has no CPU bf16 matmul kernel
